description: Mark a task or step in progress when you begin it. Starting a step also starts its task. For new work, taskhold_begin files, plans and starts in one call. Returns the id, status and the next step's id when it has steps. Safe to repeat; it also resumes a blocked or done task. An unknown task_id fails with "Task not found".

agent.description: Who is working, shown to the person: "<client> in <repo folder>", e.g. "Claude Code in api-server". Outside a repo just "Claude Code".

task_id.description: The ID of the task to start

name: taskhold_start
title: Start a task
